purpose: Role V's labelling prompt (D-706 item 1, D-707). Filled by tools/neg_synth_label.py from a label sheet alone: the round-k articles, the parties, the persona and one statement with its party and round. Never the stance, the article or wording the statement was written for, a red-line mark, round k+1 or the card.
stance_definition: - "stance": "support" when the party favours that wording outright; "oppose" when it objects to it; "accept" when it accepts it as it stands and agrees to it, and also when, in an intermediate round, it says it could support it provided a condition is met: that is a conditional acceptance, labelled "accept", not "support". Label each statement on its own words: a statement of a later round that shows the condition unmet is labelled by what that statement says;
stance_definition_decision: D-748 replaced wording (Seckin 18:48, SUPERVISOR_INBOX 18:50): in an intermediate round "could support X provided Y" is a conditional acceptance of X, labelled accept, not support; it carries forward only while Y is met; a later round showing Y unmet is labelled on its own words. A definition, not an example (D-736 item 4).
firm_field_persona: - "firm_limit": "yes" when the party says plainly that this is a limit it will not cross (for example that it cannot accept it in any form), otherwise "no".
